svg.title: π₀ Latent WAM · Visual teacher–student distillation
svg.desc: Three current RGB views and the instruction condition both experts. The teacher receives optical flow from two camera pairs, while the student learns queries. Only the student runs online. Camera frames are from the robot and the training dataset.
